inputs.prompt: ONE original white-haired young gunner, the Sunvault Zenith Lensbearer, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the short swept white hair, the small blue monocle lens over one eye, the ivory and navy long coat with gold trim and star emblems, the gold shoulder and knee armour, the gold boots and the tall gold lantern standard with a blue crystal mounted on the back. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Both hands hold ONE long gold and glass lens cannon with glowing blue crystal rings, held at the waist and pointing to screen right. Preserve the lens cannon, the back standard, the coat and the proportions. The gunner starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. The head and shoulders are thrown back, the coat swings and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the lens cannon, then the gunner steadies on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, the back standard, the whole lens cannon, the coat tails, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, beams, muzzle flash, glow bursts, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the lens cannon stays rigid and never morphs.
